name: implement a row-parallel linear layer that shards weights and all-reduces partial sums
definition: Split the weight matrix along the input dimension across ranks and sum per-rank partial outputs via an all-reduce-equivalent, with full bias retained on every rank.
failure_mode: Incorrect row partitioning or missing reduction yields wrong output

name: implement adaptive rejection sampling in r
definition: write an adaptive-rejection sampler that accepts an unnormalized log-concave density, a domain, and a sample count, returning samples that reproduce the target distribution surface.
failure_mode: wrong distribution shape (e.g. near-uniform outputs) fails the mean/std check

name: implement stability-based clustering via subsampling
definition: Implement an algorithm that evaluates clustering stability across multiple subsamples to judge each candidate cluster count, returning per-k stability statistics.
failure_mode: Stability scores identical/absent or optimal k implausible cause functional assertions to fail.

name: locate and patch java jar-upload filename sanitization
definition: Modify the source code that resolves the destination path of an uploaded jar so only the base filename is used, preventing path components from escaping the upload directory.
failure_mode: Traversal filename still writes to an absolute path on the server, failing the negative test.
